criteria.reason: Steps shown and multiplication visible, but demographic breakdown unused, 1.5→1.6 adjustment unsupported, and error arithmetic (1.48M/1.68M) wrong.
Consistent 'assume/example' hedging, but population presented as assumption rather than data; data/assumption boundary blurred.
Explicit range given ('1–3 million cups or more') but underived, bounds vague, and intermediate error figures erroneous.
No verifiable source actually cited; ICO and statistical office mentioned only hypothetically, no data anchored.

factual_errors: Population assumed at 8.8 million; actual permanent resident population was 9,127,100 (end 2025).
Per-capita assumption of 1.5–1.6 cups/day is far below reported ~1,069 cups/year (ICO 2021, ~3/day); ~14M total vs. ~27–31M implied.
Step 6 error figures (1,480,000; 1,680,000) are arithmetically wrong; a 0.1-cup error implies ~880,000 cups.
summary: Response builds a stepped, hedged estimate with an error range, but anchors on no real source, misstates population, understates consumption versus published figures, and contains arithmetic errors.
